items.effect: 67 streams drew 255,693 views and converted 8 units against 29 units the week before, so live is reaching fewer viewers and monetising them worse.
items.action: Pin the lead product on every stream, enforce a 30 minute minimum and add a two unit bundle.

items.effect: Orders and units have fallen three weeks running while views rose 10.7%, so the break is video volume and conversion per video, not reach.
items.action: Rebuild weekly video volume toward 90 posts before adding discounts, since orders per video only slipped from 0.82 to 0.68.

items.effect: Active creators fell for a third straight week after collab invites dropped to zero from 1,993 in the week of Oct 12.
items.action: Re-invite every creator who posted in the Oct 12 week but was silent last week, and resume collab invites this week.

items.effect: Third consecutive weekly decline leaves the shop at 18.1% of the 8,444.44 peak week of Oct 5.
items.action: Treat this as a supply problem and restore posting volume plus paid spend on Screen Door and Bidet in the same week.

items.effect: 31 of 32 campaigns are disabled and the one enabled Black Friday campaign recorded no spend, so the channel that carried 57.9% of October GMV is dark.
items.action: Turn Screen Door and Bidet back on at their October levels of 2,315 and 1,774 monthly spend, and keep Repel Blitz off at 0.746.

items.effect: 207 of 300 applications sit un-reviewed while 42 expired and 20 were rejected against 2 posted, so creators age out before a sample ships.
items.action: Clear the queue in 48 hours at 25 approvals per day, ranked by follower count and post rate.
